properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum account/transaction signature curve. All 52 sites are dependency declarations (secp256k1@^3.0.1/4.0.3 via ganache/ganache-core/truffle/web3/ethereumjs-*) in the root and static/node lockfiles — the shipped app bundles this curve everywhere Ethereum keys are handled. Quantum deadline risk (Shor); the curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol, so replacement is observable here but not implementable without a protocol change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.x — the npm implementation of OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF — declared transitively via browserify-aes/crypto-browserify in the ganache stack, including a nested copy under ganache-core. It derives cipher keys from passwords in browserified crypto shims. Weak-by-practice KDF shipped in the dependency tree; fixing it is upstream's move, not the app's.

properties.name: pqs:context

NOT the bcrypt password hasher itself; sibling `bcrypto` lib also present.
